Dwarkesh Patel / Dwarkesh Podcast :

An interview with OpenAI researcher Noam Brown about multi-agent systems, AI solving the Navier-Stokes problem, the internal/external model gap, and more   —  “We never want to be in a situation again where we underestimate the AI.”  —  New episode with Noam Brown.
